changelog: Consolidated update built directly for v1.3.18; v1.3.19 is skipped after its checksum failure.
Philippine Standard Time (Asia/Manila / UTC+8) is enforced for PHP and MySQL match timestamps.
Sports-360 style FIFO rotation: players who finish a match return to the end of the Queue.
Resting is removed from live rotation.
On Deck remains visible but editable until the match starts; admin can replace or shuffle players.
Public visitors can view confirmed Court 1 bookings and submit a schedule request pending Admin approval.
Schedule conflicts are shown to Admin; confirmed court time is still decided by Admin rather than automatically by submission order.
Duplicate full names are intercepted before creating a second profile, with Use Existing / Different Nickname / Discard choices.
Calendar Schedule Details and v1.3.18 active-match running time / recent-result timestamps are retained.
